newsitem.title: TURKEY: Moslems at prayer have shoes stolen in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Moslems at prayer have shoes stolen in Turkey.

text.p: Light-fingered Turkish thieves left more than 200 Moslem worshippers bare-footed, making off with their shoes as the faithful celebrated the revelation of the Koran.

Anatolian new agency said on Thursday thieves stole 210 pairs of shoes from outside the Vali Kamil Acun mosque, in the southeastern city of Sirnak. Moslems remove their shoes before entering a mosque.
The ceremony on Wednesday night was broadcast live on state television to mark the anniversary of the Koran's revelation to the Prophet Mohammed, Anatolian said.
Police investigators are expected to review the tapes for suspects.
